notes.title: Prepare to Fight in Arena 54!
notes.content:
Hello soon-to-be galactic fighters! 

10 years are almost up and the tournament is about to start! 

In our new game, Arena 54, you'll be invited to take part in a galactic tournament against different fighters from other planets. Your goal is to defeat them all and take the crystal from Doom Hammer, the most powerful warrior who's been keeping all the fighters he's defeated trapped in Arena 54. 

[b]This visual novel [/b]changes depending on your choices. All you have to do is choose...but choose wisely because one wrong choice will cost you your freedom. 

Do you think you're the one who's destined to take down Doom Hammer?

Arena 54 is coming your way [b]in August [/b]so if you'd like to participate in this exciting galactic adventure make sure you have wishlisted it. 

Choose and deal with the consequences of your choices. 

Stay tuned! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1698120/Arena_54__Visual_Novel_Action_Adventure/
